content: Prioritizing time with friends or solo adventuring can be refreshing and even healthy for personal growth, but it's crucial to communicate openly, establish boundaries, and trust each other. Devaluing your relationship or engaging in irresponsible behavior isn't constructive. Love your partner, even when apart.
